agent.prompt: Use Develop in this isolated fictional exercise. Use only the supplied records and existing supported output tools; do not contact providers, install anything, publish, start a schedule or change unrelated files. Help me explore how incoming rate changes the backlog in model.txt. Create an interactive view if the current host supports it; otherwise give a useful static fallback. A self-contained local HTML file is allowed if no in-chat renderer is available.

inputs.content: Backlog starts at 0 requests. Over 60 seconds, incoming traffic is a constant 0 to 20 requests/second and service capacity is 10 requests/second. End backlog = max(0, incoming_rate - 10) * 60 requests. This is a deterministic model with no burst or latency estimate.
